policy.note: Editorial candidates only. Promotion is explicit and gated; application code consumes canonical runtime assets only.

assets.name: Queen angelfish
assets.qaNote: Strong silhouette and palette; markings slightly stylized but recognizable.

assets.name: Hawksbill sea turtle
assets.qaNote: Excellent hooked beak, shell character and proportions.

assets.name: Spotted eagle ray
assets.qaNote: Replacement attempts improved spotting and disc shape but no reviewed replacement binary is in the source layer; original remains blocked.

assets.name: Nurse shark
assets.qaNote: Resolved: paired barbels, broad flattened head and rear-set dorsal fins make the candidate reliably recognizable at card scale.

assets.name: Green moray
assets.qaNote: Strong recognizable form, colour and head shape.

assets.name: Great barracuda
assets.qaNote: Very recognizable; teeth slightly exaggerated.

assets.name: Stoplight parrotfish
assets.qaNote: Resolved: robust parrotfish body and beak plus terminal-phase green/red pattern are sufficiently diagnostic despite restrained stylization.

assets.name: Caribbean reef squid
assets.qaNote: Resolved: elongate mantle, full-length lateral fins and reef-squid posture are recognizable; multi-animal composition is acceptable editorially.

assets.name: Caribbean spiny lobster
assets.qaNote: Excellent antennae, armored body and coloration.

assets.name: Caribbean reef octopus
assets.qaNote: Resolved to remake: attractive generic octopus form does not carry enough Octopus briareus-specific identity for an identification-led collection.

assets.name: French angelfish
assets.qaNote: Strong species-specific coloration and silhouette.

assets.name: Spotted trunkfish
assets.qaNote: Replacement attempts still inverted the adult field pattern; target is pale/whitish with dense dark spots, not a dark body with white spots. Blocked.

assets.name: Queen triggerfish
assets.qaNote: Strong tail, body and facial coloration; source-only until content authority maps it.

assets.name: Nassau grouper
assets.qaNote: Broad bars, grouper form and head pattern work well.

assets.name: Blue tang
assets.qaNote: Replacement attempts continued to read as Indo-Pacific Paracanthurus hepatus. Target is Atlantic Acanthurus coeruleus; blocked.

assets.name: Southern stingray
assets.qaNote: Convincing silhouette and dorsal view.

assets.name: Trumpetfish
assets.qaNote: Resolved: extremely elongate body, tubular snout and small posterior fins make Aulostomus maculatus recognizable at gallery scale.

assets.name: Longsnout seahorse
assets.qaNote: Resolved: long snout and slender seahorse profile are usable; colour is variable in life, so identity confidence remains medium rather than overstated.

assets.name: Yellowtail snapper
assets.qaNote: Excellent profile, stripe/tail and silver-blue body.

assets.name: Porcupinefish
assets.qaNote: Strong Diodon-type asset; canonical label must match.

assets.name: Longspine sea urchin
assets.qaNote: Excellent and highly recognizable; source-only until content authority maps it.

assets.name: Banded coral shrimp
assets.qaNote: Strong red/white banding, antennae and claw profile; source-only until content authority maps it.

assets.name: Schoolmaster snapper
assets.qaNote: Good yellow fins/stripes and snapper silhouette.

assets.name: Spanish hogfish
assets.qaNote: Replacement attempts still missed the adult Bodianus rufus yellow/lilac diagnostic colour division. Blocked.

assets.name: Caribbean cushion sea star
assets.qaNote: Replacement attempts improved texture but did not consistently achieve the thick inflated arms and cushion-like Oreaster reticulatus body. Original remains blocked and source-only.

assets.name: Sergeant major
assets.qaNote: Strong five-bar appearance and Caribbean reef-fish form.

assets.name: Porkfish
assets.qaNote: Replacement attempts produced too many broad vertical bars. Adult porkfish needs the characteristic two black bars with yellow striping; blocked.

assets.name: Queen conch
assets.qaNote: Replacement attempts retained a plausible shell but omitted diagnostic visible soft anatomy such as eyestalks/proboscis. Blocked and source-only.

assets.name: Juvenile spotted drum
assets.qaNote: Strong juvenile black/white profile with trailing fins; source-only until content authority maps it.

assets.name: Green sea turtle
assets.qaNote: Good rounded head and smoother shell distinguish it from hawksbill.
